viirs_transition: Recorded change, Punjab + Haryana, 2011 → 2012: all included satellites, +455.2%; Terra+Aqua, +5.3%; difference, 449.8 percentage points. Neither percentage is a corrected estimate of fire activity, and the difference is not a causal attribution. Actual-fire change is not measured.
noaa20_transition: Recorded change, Punjab + Haryana, 2017 → 2018: all included satellites, +99.0%; Terra+Aqua+Suomi NPP, +11.4%; difference, 87.6 percentage points. Neither percentage is a corrected estimate of fire activity, and the difference is not a causal attribution. Actual-fire change is not measured.
snpp_cessation: Recorded change, Punjab + Haryana, 2025 → 2026: all included satellites, −19.0%; Terra+Aqua+Suomi NPP+NOAA-20, −19.0%. Both periods cover Oct 1 through Nov 14; Nov 15 is excluded from this comparison, and 2026 Nov 15 is unverified, not yet retrieved. The two views coincide because the same four satellites are included in both seasons, so the decomposition cannot show the interruption. The included-satellite record is interrupted: S-NPP recorded cell-days run 1 Oct – 2 Nov, and zero from 3 Nov, while NOAA-20 continues. Actual-fire change is not measured.
